pages.title: Golden Jackal
pages.text: The golden jackal ($(o)Canis aureus$()) lives in south-eastern Europe, the Middle East and southern Asia.$(br2)It is a small, slim canid with a golden to tawny coat, a grizzled darker saddle on its back, a pale throat and belly, and a bushy, dark-tipped tail.$(br2)An adaptable omnivore, it has spread north-west across Europe in recent decades, reaching as far as the Baltic states and Denmark.
